name: De Moivre's formula
formula: (cos t + i sin t)^n = cos(nt) + i sin(nt)

name: Roots of unity
formula: z_k = cos(2 pi k/n) + i sin(2 pi k/n)

name: Euler's formula
formula: e^(ix) = cos x + i sin x

name: Area of a circle via diameter
Law of sines
formula: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C

name: Median property
formula: medians meet at a point dividing them 2:1

name: Inscribed angle theorem
formula: inscribed angle = half of central angle

name: Tangent of a sum
formula: tan(x+y) = (tan x + tan y)/(1 - tan x tan y)

name: Sine of a sum
formula: sin(x+y) = sin x cos y + cos x sin y

name: Cosine of a sum
formula: cos(x+y) = cos x cos y - sin x sin y

name: Sine of a difference
formula: sin(x-y) = sin x cos y - cos x sin y

name: Cosine of a difference
formula: cos(x-y) = cos x cos y + sin x sin y

name: Sum to product (sine)
formula: sin x + sin y = 2 sin((x+y)/2) cos((x-y)/2)

name: Difference to product (cosine)
formula: cos x - cos y = -2 sin((x+y)/2) sin((x-y)/2)

name: Tangent definition
formula: tan x = sin x / cos x

name: Integration by parts
formula: int u dv = uv - int v du

name: Volume of a solid of revolution
Newton's first law
formula: a body stays at rest or moves uniformly unless acted on by a force

name: Pascal's law
formula: pressure is transmitted equally in all directions

name: Bernoulli's equation
formula: P + rho v^2/2 + rho g h = const

name: Speed of sound in a gas
Ohm's law for a full circuit
Coulomb's law in a dielectric
formula: F = q1q2/(4 pi eps eps0 r^2)

name: Ampere-Maxwell law
formula: curl B = mu0 J + mu0 eps0 dE/dt

name: Law of reflection
formula: angle of incidence equals angle of reflection

name: Snell's law
formula: n1 sin t1 = n2 sin t2

name: Fine structure constant
formula: alpha = e^2/(4 pi eps0 hbar c)

name: Law of conservation of mass
formula: mass of reactants equals mass of products

name: Avogadro's law
formula: equal volumes of gases contain equal numbers of molecules

name: Addition rule of probability
formula: P(A or B) = P(A)+P(B)-P(A and B)

name: Central limit theorem (statement)
formula: sum of independent variables tends to normal distribution

name: Law of large numbers (statement)
formula: sample mean tends to expected value

name: Kepler's first law
formula: planets move in ellipses with the Sun at one focus

name: Kepler's second law
formula: a planet sweeps equal areas in equal times

name: Moore's law
formula: transistor count doubles roughly every 2 years

name: Cayley-Hamilton theorem (statement)
formula: a matrix satisfies its own characteristic equation

name: Fundamental theorem of arithmetic
formula: every integer >1 has a unique prime factorization

name: Chinese remainder theorem (statement)
formula: system of congruences has a unique solution mod product

name: Sum of divisors function
formula: sigma(n) = sum of divisors of n

name: Handshaking lemma
formula: sum of vertex degrees = 2 * number of edges

name: Dijkstra's algorithm (concept)
formula: finds shortest paths from a source vertex

name: Kirchhoff's theorem (spanning trees)
formula: number of spanning trees via matrix-tree theorem

name: Four color theorem (statement)
formula: any planar map can be colored with 4 colors

name: Runge-Kutta 4th order (concept)
formula: weighted average of four slope estimates

name: Bisection method (concept)
formula: repeatedly halves an interval containing a root

name: Sum of an infinite series (p-series test)
Scalar triple product
formula: a . (b x c) = volume of parallelepiped

name: Volume of a tetrahedron by vectors
Efficiency of a real engine (Otto cycle)
Biot-Savart law
formula: dB = (mu0/4pi) I dl x r / r^3

Critical angle for total internal reflection
Relation between Gibbs energy and equilibrium constant
Turing machine transition function (concept)
formula: delta: Q x Gamma -> Q x Gamma x {L,R}
